unit.why: A short narrative: the tsaddik wants to divorce his wife because they have no daughter, she weeps and prays, and she miraculously gives birth to a daughter after menopause.
unit.boundary_note: part of a genealogical chapter; the previous division lists the five sons and the daughter Perl Gittel, and this story explains her birth

stories.start_quote: וכתב לי הגה"ק רי״מ הנ"ל מספינקא
stories.summary_en: After five sons, Hinda stopped menstruating, and her husband R. Y.A. wanted to divorce her because they had no daughter; she wept and prayed, God heard her, and she bore a daughter.

quotes: ששמע הש״י תפלתה וילדה עוד בת
tags.why: the birth is presented as answered prayer
the planned divorce drives the plot

tags.why: Hinda acts through weeping, speech and prayer
